title: Unique Manifest Number
description: Every SwiftCargo account is anchored to one email address, the same way a vessel gets one registration number. Prove the database itself won't allow a second account to claim an address that's already on file.
successCondition: POST /api/auth/register twice with the identical email (any password/role) returns 201 the first time and 409 with { error: { code: "CONFLICT" } } the second time. Checking the users table via `npm run db:psql` (`select count(*) from users where email = '<the email>';`) afterward shows exactly 1 row, not 2 — the rejected second attempt never inserted anything.
hints: The users.email column carries a unique constraint at the Prisma/Postgres level (see prisma/schema.prisma) — the API's 409 is just surfacing that.
Use `npm run db:psql` (documented in docs/self-host.md) to run the count query directly against Postgres.
